wb11_split.topic: The Fatah-Hamas split and Israeli policy

claims.text: Smotrich in a 2015 interview: 'The Palestinian Authority is a burden, and Hamas is an asset' — reasoning that the PA hurt Israel in international forums while Hamas, as a terror organization, would never be recognized or bring cases at the ICC or UN.
Smotrich's 2017 Decisive Plan, per Ron Ben-Yishai: flood the West Bank with settlement; Palestinians would choose life under Israeli rule, emigration, or death as 'shahid'.

2024: Smotrich withheld PA clearance revenues (~70% of PA budget); security officials (unnamed) said this weakens the PA and helps Hamas grow in West Bank cities; his office said the PA 'promotes terror, pays for terror and acts against Israel in the international arena'.

29 Apr 2021 Abbas postponed the May parliamentary and July presidential elections, citing Israel not committing to allow voting in East Jerusalem; critics said Fatah's split meant Hamas was likely to win most seats; last parliamentary election 2006; US and Israel wary of Hamas's participation.
Reconciliation agreements: Mecca 2007 followed by Hamas seizure of Gaza; Cairo 2011, Doha 2012, Beach Camp 2014, Cairo 2017 all unimplemented; Beijing Declaration 2024.

PA-Israel security coordination since Oslo aims to prevent attacks on Israelis; Abbas called it 'sacred'; deeply unpopular among Palestinians; suspended Jan 2023 after a Jenin raid killed 10, then quietly walked back.
Dec 2023 Netanyahu: 'I will not replace Hamastan with Fatahstan', rejecting a US request to hand Gaza to the PA.
